card.architecture: HiDream-I1 17B MoE DiT (quad encoder), step-distilled Fast
card.summary: The Fast (16-step distilled) HiDream-I1 variant. Same 17B quad-encoder model as Full/Dev but the quickest — strong prompt adherence in ~16 steps at cfg 1, no negative prompt.
card.pick_when: You want HiDream's prompt adherence as fast as possible on a 24 GB card.

prompt.guidance: Detailed natural-language prose; distilled (cfg 1, no negative).
prompt.example: A paper-craft diorama of a tiny town in autumn, warm low sun, intricate folds, shallow depth of field
prompt.instructions: Write rich natural language. Fast is step-distilled: ~16 steps, cfg 1, lcm/normal, flow-shift 3. Negative prompts have no effect.
dont: Supply a negative prompt (no effect at cfg 1)

speed.measured_note: 17B MoE Q5_K_M, ~16 steps on 24 GB; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in detail. Follows instructions closely; the fastest HiDream.
